verdict.rationale: An audit log of user and administrative actions is a fair governance question for a code-hosting platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an audit log or activity history. The nearby items describe adjacent controls only: granular permissions, 2FA and IP allowlisting, SOC2/ISO compliance, merge checks, and centralized pipeline visibility. None of these show that a devops lead can review a log of user and admin actions.
